recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#F5F5F5).
2. Place a dark red (#8B0000) bordered header bar at the top, full width, containing the title text "Required to PENALIZE small values of Precision and Recall" in large bold dark red (#8B0000) sans-serif on the left; underline the word "PENALIZE" in bright red (#FF0000).
3. Place a yellow filled circle (#FFFF00) at the top-right corner of the header bar with black (#000000) text "15".
4. Place a blue-bordered (#0000FF) white (#FFFFFF) rectangular box in the middle-left, approx 45% width.
5. Inside the box from step 4, place the heading "Remember:" in black (#000000).
6. Inside the box from step 4, place the line "Ranges of Precision and Recall are from 0 to 1" with "Precision" and "Recall" in blue (#0000FF) and "from 0 to 1" in red (#FF0000).
7. Inside the box from step 4, place the line "Using 1/Precision and 1/Recall" with "Precision" and "Recall" in blue (#0000FF) and the fractions "1/Precision" and "1/Recall" in red (#FF0000), stacked vertically.
8. Place a 2D Cartesian graph in the middle-right, approx 50% width, on a graph-paper style grid.
9. In the graph from step 8, draw x and y axes with tick numbers from -5 to 5 on both axes and axis labels "x" and "y" in black (#000000).
10. In the graph from step 8, plot the hyperbola y=1/x in black (#000000) in quadrants I and III, and label the curve "y = 1/x".
11. In the graph from step 8, overlay a yellow elliptical highlight (#FFFF00) on the steep portion of the curve near the positive y-axis, with red line segments (#FF0000) marking the highlight boundary.
12. Place a large blue-bordered (#0000FF) white (#FFFFFF) rectangular box across the bottom, full width.
13. Inside the box from step 12, place the first derivation line: "As Precision/Recall Decreases ⇒ Value of (1/Precision) and (1/Recall) Increases" with "Precision" and "Recall" in blue (#0000FF), "Decreases" and "Increases" in green (#008000), and the fractions in red (#FF0000).
14. Inside the box from step 12, place the second derivation line: "Define: 1/F1 = 1/Precision + 1/Recall ⇒ F1 increases as both Precision and Recall are high values" with "Precision", "Recall", and "F1" in blue (#0000FF), "increases" in green (#008000), and the fractions in red (#FF0000).
15. Inside the box from step 12, place the third derivation line: "F1 Range is from 0 to 0.5 ⇒ Normalize" with "F1" in blue (#0000FF), "from 0 to 0.5" in red (#FF0000), and "Normalize" in green (#008000).
16. Inside the box from step 12 at the bottom-right, place a peach/light-orange (#FFDAB9) rounded rectangle containing the equation "1/F1 = 0.5 (1/Precision + 1/Recall)" with "F1", "Precision", and "Recall" in blue (#0000FF), "0.5" in red (#FF0000), and the fractions in red (#FF0000), stacked vertically.
